build_k_hop_subgraph: build a k-hop subgraph extractor that returns nodes, edges, and masks around a central node
create_make_graph: create a NetworkX DiGraph from raw graph data with optional pruning and reverse relations
prepare_embeddings: prepare node embeddings from GloVe, Word2Vec, or FastText files with multi-word averaging fallback
build_graph_network_module: build a GraphNetworkModule that loads a knowledge graph, prepares node features, and runs GCN forward passes
run_graph_network: run a GraphNetwork with GCN, RGCN, or SAGE conv layers and optional special node input and graph-level output
